claims.text: Follow-Up Builder is a free AI builder on blackarrow.ltd/tools that drafts a follow-up sequence around the user's business
The tools page offers this at no cost with no signup or card required

disclosure: Reflects a well-documented pattern in sales response research showing steep drop-off in follow-up speed after the first few minutes; no single named study is cited for the specific SLA-adoption comparison, so the claim is stated as a general pattern rather than a precise benchmark.

claims.text: Businesses that put their response-time rule in writing hit their target far more often than those relying on memory alone.
Most teams miss the 5-minute response window even when they consider it essential.
Black Arrow's platform includes automated missed-call text-back that responds within seconds, including nights and weekends.
The free Lead Response Audit scores a business's response process from four inputs.
